C1622.title: OpenAI Voice Cloning Technology Sparks Biden Impersonation Incident
C1622.summary: In January 2024, someone used deepfake technology to clone U.S. President Biden's voice and made fraudulent calls to New Hampshire residents in an attempt to disrupt normal voting. This prompted the U.S. Federal Communications Commission to take action, declaring such activities illegal. OpenAI also strengthened anti-abuse measures when releasing its Voice Engine.

references.title: Is Deepfake Scary? OpenAI Now Wants to Clone Your Voice
